sacraments.text: Download and print the application, then email a scan or hand it in at the office. Attach the child’s birth certificate, the parents’ civil marriage certificate, church marriage certificate if any, the baptism certificate of one or both parents, and the godparents’ confirmation certificate or extract. Rehearsal and briefing one week before the baptism at 16:00. Ask the office for baptism dates.
Approach priest directly during weekend to make appointment.
